statements.attributed: Mapping the world of complex concentrated alloys (2017) provided the framework for compiling density and mechanical properties of CCAs published since 2004 to evaluate performance indices.
statements.quote: Thus, this data article is a compilation of the density and mechanical properties of CCAs published in the literature since 2004, allowing the performance indices for lighter, stronger and stiffer structures to be evaluated for different loading conditions .

statements.attributed: Mapping the world of complex concentrated alloys (2017) was used by Gorsse et al. with Cambridge Education Software (CES) to browse, search, filter, plot property maps, and select materials using performance indices.
statements.quote: The database was used by Gorsse et al. with Cambridge Education Software (CES) enabling users to (i) browse the materials data, (ii) search and filter to narrow down the set of materials using given parameters (e.g. alloy composition that contains a specific chemical element), (iii) represent material property maps by plotting any properties or combination of properties against any other property, and (iv) select materials using performance indices as defined by M.
